column5: law
A partial codeword emits no logical transition.
Successful decoding emits exactly the declared logical stream.
Physical codec bytes are never exposed as semantic labels.
Byte semantics require explicit byte-profile selection.
Noncanonical overlong ULEB terminators are rejected.
An unterminated ULEB stream is rejected without output.
UTF-8 continuation bytes cannot begin a scalar codeword.
Rejected input returns an explicit failure and no semantic output.
Decoder state is bounded by consumed input, not an application policy limit.
Adjacent canonical codewords decode as distinct atoms.
Incomplete buffered input cannot increment completed-atom count.
Every finite input reaches a terminal success or explicit failure.
Published atom-to-ID relation is a total exact bijection.
Fingerprint collisions are resolved by full atom equality.
Retired IDs are never reused as live identifiers.
Every live ID resolves to its exact durable payload and span.
Active allocation claims cannot overwrite a live ID.
Aborted allocations are not visible logical bindings.
Published vocabulary frontier never exceeds durable frontier.
Every published ID has exact durable metadata.
A durable sequence references only a durable compatible vocabulary.
Sequence publication follows vocabulary durability.
A sequence descriptor binds the exact vocabulary generation/fiber.
A published head binds one coherent vocabulary/sequence pair.
Recovery yields coherent old state, coherent new state, or explicit error.
A saved continuation resumes against its immutable snapshot pair.
Unavailable/corrupt head artifacts never become empty success.
Published heads contain no dangling ID reference.
Packed spans are disjoint and cover the canonical byte store exactly.
Allocation statuses partition all allocated IDs.
Every materialized codeword is governed by its descriptor.
Recovery never converts missing data into an empty dictionary.
Equal raw IDs in different term fibers remain distinct.
Multi-span identity witnesses retain concrete spans.
An owner ever published remains immutable for that generation.
Two-generation term-fiber witnesses remain concrete and distinguishable.
Physical codec bytes never appear as logical labels.
One UTF-8 scalar is one logical transition.
Suffix matching starts only at logical-unit boundaries.
Specialized kernels preserve the complete declared observation.
Format identity comes from explicit profile metadata, never Rust type names.
Mismatched vocabulary fibers are rejected before traversal.
